purpose_context: Agents working across sessions and clones need to recover project intent, decisions, assumptions, failed approaches, verification, and handoffs without depending on a vendor memory service or treating retrieved text as trusted instructions. This mission defines repository-native memory events, deterministic supersession and contradiction semantics, policy-controlled safe recall, and rebuildable local indexes on top of the identity and selective-replication foundations established by the operational self-hosting alpha.
purpose_tldr: Give agents durable, distributed, signed project memory bound to exact Git and Nichthub state.
